spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact DOM/Fetch contract: abort(reason) rejects a pending fetch with the identical value, no-argument abort mints an AbortError DOMException, and signal.reason/throwIfAborted retain the value — each checked by identity against a real aborted fetch.

interactive.rationale: A radio group selects the reason kind, both buttons run real fetch()+abort() calls, and the readout renders the actual rejection value, identity check, and signal state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises reason-kind selection plus identity/signal.reason/throwIfAborted inspection, which is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the no-argument default, non-Error reasons (string, structured object), the pre-aborted-signal path that rejects before dispatch, and the rare resolved-before-abort race with an honest inconclusive message.

references.rationale: Links the Fetch Standard abort steps, MDN AbortSignal.reason, and the feature index carries the ChromeStatus 5158507786665984 link.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the same contracts (signal-reason-identity, pending-fetch-rejects-with-reason, default-abort-mints-aborterror) with falsifiable identity checks; all three pass on this Chromium 141 as expected for the Chrome 98-era half.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP driver run 2026-08-16 (f1-basics.png): Error-reason run showed rejection === reason yes, pre-aborted run showed identity true for throwIfAborted and fetch rejection, no-argument run showed the minted AbortError; zero console errors, only the intentional bannered net::ERR_ABORTED entries.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts abort-basics-pending-reason-identity, abort-basics-default-aborterror, and abort-basics-preaborted-identity after the real runs; no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: All colours are design-system variables; buttons keep the dark bg/ivory text pair; verdict colours (emerald/rose) sit on near-white backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios in a fieldset with a legend, native buttons, results in a role=status dl and an output element, visible focus-visible outlines, and all controls keyboard-operable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes (desktop clean; mobile warning only for text links); the readout dl collapses to one column under 560px so nothing overflows at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: async button action result status live region error state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair colour-coded status with text, use semantic containers (fieldset/legend, output, role=status) and keep controls native.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Reason picker is a native radio fieldset; results render as text in a role=status definition list and an output element; verdict colour is always accompanied by explicit yes/no text.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio group selection for a single choice with keyboard support
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native radio inputs with labels for mutually exclusive choices instead of custom toggles.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The five reason kinds are native radios with for/id-associated labels and 22px accent-coloured controls in 44px rows.

summary: Canonical half of the feature: real fetches aborted with user-chosen reasons, rejection identity checked and rendered honestly. Verified via CDP driver (three interaction sequences, zero console errors) and the feature-level responsive harness on both classes after the final edit.
